note: Health is genuinely the neglected area — two years of nothing after knee surgery — and he is not the gym-averse profile the exclusion targets: he has gym access, could train five days a week, trains jiu-jitsu and had already restarted on his own. Everything else misses. Successful cannot be assessed at all because occupation was never asked in eighteen minutes, and an unverifiable criterion should count against fit rather than be assumed in its favour; all that is known is that his workplace has a gym. Income fails on the disclosed position: he declined at $6,000 while actively paying down debt. Starting point is rescue rather than good-to-great — 240 lb, a beer gut he wants gone, two years detrained and rebuilding from a reconstruction. The rollup point is about routing rather than about him: he was a full closer call that reached the price at minute ten and converted to a $199/month subscription, which is a setter-stage qualification outcome reached at closer cost. Set against the manager's 12 June description of the real target — men in their forties and fifties who need to lose twenty to forty pounds — he is closer to the company's actual buyer than to its stated ICP, and the thing that stopped him was liquidity, not fit.
